preset: 08 Games - Stars in Shadow (4X Strategy/2D Sprite)
style: Palette of periwinkle blue, dawn rose pink and warm starlight cream over deep indigo night.

images.name: coming-home
images.prompt: Side-view scene at golden hour: the overgrown ruins of a once-cozy homestead on a grassy hillside, its walls crumbled and wrapped in vines and young trees, an old chunky six-wheeled rover rusted and half buried in moss beside it, a collapsed greenhouse dome full of wildflowers. A person in a cream and periwinkle work jumpsuit with a small backpack stands in front of the ruins, quietly looking at them. High in the sky an enormous long carrier starship with cream hull plating and periwinkle stripes waits. Gentle melancholy and wonder. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

images.name: dig
images.prompt: Side-view cross-section of a hillside filling the wide frame: on the surface a small house with a garden; below it colourful layered rock strata, and a dug tunnel where a person in a cream and periwinkle work jumpsuit breaks rock with a handheld digging tool, neat piles of grey stone, brown soil and glittering blue crystal stacked beside the tunnel entrance, a lamp lighting the tunnel.

images.name: drive
images.prompt: Side view at sunset on a grassy plain: a chunky six-wheeled rover with a bubble cockpit drives up the lowered rear ramp into the open, lit cargo bay of a landed stubby boxy dropship with four landing legs and a cream and periwinkle hull, a person in a cream and periwinkle work jumpsuit walking up the ramp behind it, distant hills and a huge soft star setting.

images.name: dock
images.prompt: Side view in orbit above a planet's curved horizon: a stubby boxy dropship with a cream and periwinkle hull flies into the open glowing hangar bay underneath an enormous long rounded carrier starship with cream hull plating and periwinkle stripes, tiny crew visible inside the hangar, stars and a soft glowing star beyond.

images.name: bridge
images.prompt: Interior of a spacious starship bridge seen from the side: a calm crew in cream and periwinkle uniforms at rounded consoles in front of a huge curved window filled by a glowing three-dimensional map of star systems linked by thin paths of light, one crew member pointing at a distant star, soft warm lighting.

images.name: asteroid
images.prompt: A tiny round asteroid world floating in space, so small that its curved surface wraps all the way around: a little cabin, a few trees, a winding path and a vegetable patch along its rim, a person in a cream and periwinkle work jumpsuit walking on top of it, a parked chunky six-wheeled rover on its side, a soft glowing star nearby and other worlds as round discs in the distance.

images.name: chaos
images.prompt: A drifting heap of spaceship wreckage, crates and debris in orbit being pulled into a shimmering tear in space, the rift dark violet-black at its center with crackling electric arcs and rainbow chromatic fringes around its edges, fragments folding and merging together as they fall in, a planet's curved horizon below and stars beyond.

images.name: gardener
images.prompt: A lush terraced garden valley on an alien world in the morning: stepped green terraces of crops and flowers, little waterfalls between them, greenhouse domes and a small cozy settlement, people tending the plants, a soft glowing star in a pastel sky with a ringed planet visible above.

images.name: guardian
images.prompt: From a rocky ridge at dusk, a small team of people in light periwinkle armor beside a chunky six-wheeled rover look down into a wide canyon where a strange glowing alien hive of bulbous pods and tendrils spreads across the rocks, the team watching calmly from a safe distance.

images.name: pathfinder
images.prompt: A small exploration ship with a cream hull flies toward a vast field of strange floating chunks of reshuffled matter: half-planets fused with crystal, old wreckage merged into rock, glowing anomalies, and behind them a colossal curved wall of swirling multicoloured cosmic storms rising like a cliff.
